description: Side-by-side claims, recommendation tiers, and trust for two or more org_* ids. When the charities are measured in different outcome units (for example wellbeing in WELLBYs versus lives saved), units_differ.sentence says so in plain words; the units can't be converted without a moral judgment, which is the donor's. Answers carry decision_brief: the charity's own donate_url (next_action), the evaluator's fund as a let-the-evaluator-choose alternative, the like-for-like comparison page when one exists, and modeled: true / guaranteed: false when figures are present. No figure, rating or order is added.
name: compare_charities
title: Compare charities
